e.title: cplm (R)
e.summary: 复合泊松线性模型 R 包（Yanwei Zhang）：纯保费建模的频率-严重度联合似然/贝叶斯方法
e.body: cplm 实现复合泊松线性模型（Compound Poisson Linear Models, CPLM）的似然与贝叶斯方法（Yanwei Zhang，基于 Zhang (2013) 论文 doi:10.1007/s11222-012-9343-7）：把理赔频率与严重度联合进一个 Tweedie 复合泊松模型，直接建模纯保费——非寿险定价的核心技术。与 [[tweedie]]（Tweedie 分布工具）、[[claim-frequency]]（DAV 理赔频率）互补——CPLM 是频率+严重度一体的建模路线。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuar-r]]。
e.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v0.7-12.1，Yanwei Zhang，CPLM 似然+贝叶斯方法（Zhang 2013 CSDA 论文），依赖 tweedie/statmod
e.summary_en: R package for compound Poisson linear models (Yanwei Zhang): likelihood/Bayesian methods for pure-premium frequency-severity modelling
e.summary_hk: 複合泊松線性模型 R 包（Yanwei Zhang）：純保費建模的頻率-嚴重度聯合似然/貝葉斯方法
e.body_en: cplm implements likelihood-based and Bayesian methods for compound Poisson linear models (CPLM) (Yanwei Zhang, based on the paper Zhang (2013), doi:10.1007/s11222-012-9343-7): joining claim frequency and severity into one Tweedie compound-Poisson model to model the pure premium directly — a core technique of non-life pricing. Complements [[tweedie]] (Tweedie distribution tools) and [[claim-frequency]] (DAV claim frequency) — CPLM is the frequency+severity-in-one modelling route. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[actuar-r]].
e.body_hk: cplm 實現複合泊松線性模型（Compound Poisson Linear Models, CPLM）的似然與貝葉斯方法（Yanwei Zhang，基於 Zhang (2013) 論文 doi:10.1007/s11222-012-9343-7）：把理賠頻率與嚴重度聯合進一個 Tweedie 複合泊松模型，直接建模純保費——非壽險定價的核心技術。與 [[tweedie]]（Tweedie 分佈工具）、[[claim-frequency]]（DAV 理賠頻率）互補——CPLM 是頻率+嚴重度一體的建模路線。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuar-r]]。
